response.justification: Despite extensive software engineering experience, the candidate lacks demonstrable C++ development on Windows, SQL Server/Oracle expertise in capital markets, and any direct fixed income or investment banking domain exposure — all mandatory requirements for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven track record in CI/CD, testing practices, and DevOps infrastructure
Active open-source contributor with technical communication skills
concerns: No evidence of C++ development on Windows platform in recent roles
No mention of SQL Server, Oracle, or fixed income/capital markets domain experience
Primary tech stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, not C++ or financial systems
